import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Preserve cursor ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account_id group only (never cross account boundaries)
    df["rate_filled"] = df.groupby("account_id", sort=False)["rate"].ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 only when original rate was NULL AND a prior valid rate existed
    # (i.e., the filled value is not null but the original was null)
    df["was_carried"] = (
        (df["rate"].isna()) & (df["rate_filled"].notna())
    ).astype("int64")

    result = df[["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtypes
    result["account_id"] = result["account_id"].astype("int64")
    result["obs_seq"] = result["obs_seq"].astype("int64")
    result["obs_date"] = result["obs_date"].astype("datetime64[us]")
    result["rate_filled"] = result["rate_filled"].astype("float64")
    result["was_carried"] = result["was_carried"].astype("int64")

    return {"rate_filled": result}
